text:
maya: Spotted a sudden degraded state in the us-west-2 GPU warm pool right after the HSM rotation + firewall push. KMS decrypts failing and audit exporter getting 403s. Anyone oncall?

ops-bot: Alert: gpu-fleet-usw2 - 60 nodes degraded (auto-detected). See /runbooks/gpu-provisioning for steps.

sam: Copy — jumping in. Do we have the FW change id and exact timeframe?

maya: PR #4821 merged at ~2025-03-18T10:02Z (egress tightening). HSM rotation kicked at ~10:05Z. Quick logs below: 
```text
2025-03-18T10:06:11Z kubelet: decrypt failed: access denied (status 403) to hsm://key/abc123
2025-03-18T10:06:12Z audit-exporter: failed to POST /siem/v1/events -> 403 Forbidden
2025-03-18T10:06:13Z node-provisioner: fallback to software-crypto, queue backlog increasing
```

chen: Sounds like the firewall change blocked egress path to the SIEM/NAT or HSM proxy. Audit exporter 403 usually means the outbound IP stopped being whitelisted. Can someone check the priv-subnet routing/NAT?

alex: Confirmed — priv-subnet-3 route was pointed at a new SG/NACL that drops natgw egress after the PR. Reverting the rule now (revert PR in progress).

maya: Reverted the rule, kicking a rolling restart of the warm-pool nodes to trigger HSM handshake reattempts. ETA ~8m for nodes to rejoin.

security-bot: HSM rotation itself succeeded. Observed cached key handles expired on nodes; agent needs to re-handshake to fetch new wrapped keys. See HSM agent runbook step 4 for forced rekey.

sam: I'll tail the HSM logs for handshake failures and watch the decrypt queue. Quick cost note: provisioning backlog estimate ~3-4 hours of lag if we don't clear, ~12k extra GPU-minutes in the worst case. Keeping ops and finance in the loop.

luis: Tagging this as incident-2025-03-18-gpu-egress-hsm for postmortem and compliance audit.

maya: Thanks all. If nodes don't recover within 15m I'll escalate to platform and open a rollback for the regional FW change. @sam please add any artifacts to the incident thread. :thumbsup:
